target.title: Verify signed marketplace feed refresh
target.body:
## Summary

- Wire signed marketplace feed profiles into hosted catalog refresh using the signed envelope verifier and configured threshold.
- Persist bounded signed-feed trust state with hosted snapshots, and re-verify signed snapshots with the current source profile before using them.
- Count signed-feed thresholds over unique normalized Ed25519 public-key material so duplicate key IDs or duplicate key material cannot weaken a multi-signature threshold.
- Keep signed profiles fail-closed on invalid live bodies or unsigned old snapshots, without changing install eligibility or the existing marketplace refresh/entries payload shape.

## Validation

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/config/zod-schema.marketplaces.test.ts src/plugins/official-external-plugin-catalog-envelope.test.ts src/plugins/official-external-plugin-catalog.test.ts`
- `pnpm exec oxlint --deny-warnings src/plugins/official-external-plugin-catalog-envelope.ts src/plugins/official-external-plugin-catalog-envelope.test.ts src/config/zod-schema.ts src/config/zod-schema.marketplaces.test.ts`
- `pnpm exec oxfmt --check src/plugins/official-external-plugin-catalog-envelope.ts src/plugins/official-external-plugin-catalog-envelope.test.ts src/config/zod-schema.ts src/config/zod-schema.marketplaces.test.ts`
- `pnpm tsgo:core`
- `pnpm db:kysely:check`
- `git diff --check`
- `codex review --base fork/feeds-trust-source-profiles` - clean after verifier hardening

## Real behavior proof

Source harness from this branch generated an Ed25519 key, signed a hosted catalog feed envelope, loaded it through a signed feed profile, verified persisted snapshot trust state, then attempted offline fallback from an unsigned old snapshot under the same signed profile.

```json
{
  "acceptedSource": "hosted",
  "acceptedEntries": [
    "@openclaw/signed-proof"
  ],
  "acceptedTrust": {
    "mode": "signed",
    "signedBy": "proof-root",
    "signatureCount": 1,
    "threshold": 1,
    "verifiedAt": "2026-07-01T00:00:01.000Z"
  },
  "snapshotTrust": {
    "mode": "signed",
    "signedBy": "proof-root",
    "signatureCount": 1,
    "threshold": 1,
    "verifiedAt": "2026-07-01T00:00:01.000Z"
  },
  "unsignedSnapshotRejected": true,
  "unsignedSnapshotError": "hosted catalog feed offline mode; snapshot fallback failed: hosted catalog signed envelope is malformed"
}
```

Additional ClawSweeper fix proof:
The config schema rejects malformed raw base64url signing keys, duplicate signed-feed key IDs, and duplicate normalized public keys. The envelope verifier also counts threshold satisfaction over unique normalized public-key material, with regression coverage proving two key IDs backed by the same public key cannot satisfy `threshold: 2`.

## Stack notes

This is OpenClaw trust series PR #4 / OpenClaw PR #3, stacked after:

- #98299 signed hosted feed envelope verifier primitives
- #98316 source-profile trust config at `16cbe678ce`

The PR currently targets `main` as a draft because the dependency branches are on the fork. Reviewers should focus on the top commit `3ce0cfafaf` until the earlier trust PRs land.
